DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Establish, implement, document and maintain a Risk Management System throughout the lifecycle
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must be updated based on post-market monitoring data

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Apply data governance and management practices for training, validation and testing data sets
CONDITION: High-risk AI systems using model training
EXCEPTION: Non-training AI systems apply criteria only to testing data (Art. 10(6))
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Special category personal data processing allowed strictly for bias detection under safeguards (Art. 4a)

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Draw up technical documentation demonstrating compliance and keep up to date
CONDITION: High-risk AI systems prior to placing on market
EXCEPTION: Simplified technical documentation form available for SMEs/Start-ups (Art. 11(1))
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must be kept for 10 years after market placement (Art. 18)

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Ensure high-risk AI systems technically allow automatic recording of events (logs)
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Logs must be kept for at least 6 months under provider control (Art. 19)

RIGHT_OR_INTEREST: User Informed Choice and Proper Use
DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Provide clear instructions for use and ensure operation is sufficiently transparent
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must include capabilities, limitations, and human oversight specifications

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Design AI system with appropriate human-machine interface tools for effective human oversight
EXCEPTION: Law enforcement derogation for dual natural person verification (Art. 14(5))
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must enable stop button intervention and address automation bias

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Ensure appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity throughout lifecycle
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must implement technical measures against data poisoning, model evasion, and feedback loops

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Put in place a documented Quality Management System (QMS)
EXCEPTION: Financial institutions fulfill QMS via sector governance rules (Art. 17(4))
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Proportionate to organization size for SMEs/Start-ups

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Use high-risk AI system in accordance with accompanying instructions for use and assign oversight to trained staff
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Deployers exercising control over input data must ensure input relevance (Art. 26(4))

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting high-risk AI system into service at workplace
CONDITION: Employer deployers using high-risk AI at work
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Must comply with national/Union labor consultation rules

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Perform Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) prior to deploying high-risk AI system
CONDITION: Public bodies and private entities providing public services deploying Annex III AI
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: May cross-reference DPIA conducted under GDPR Art. 35

RIGHT_OR_INTEREST: Public Transparency and Synthetic Content Detection
DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Mark synthetic outputs in machine-readable format and disclose deepfakes/emotion recognition
CONDITION: AI systems interacting with humans or generating synthetic/deepfake content
EXCEPTION: Law enforcement crime detection exemptions; purely creative/artistic works (limited disclosure)
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 99(4))
LIMITATIONS: Marking must be effective, interoperable, robust, and reliable

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Draw up technical documentation, copyright policy, and publish training content summary
CONDITION: Placing general-purpose AI model on EU market
EXCEPTION: Free and open-source models exempt from technical docs if non-systemic (Art. 53(2))
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 101)
LIMITATIONS: Must comply with EU copyright reservation under Directive 2019/790 Art. 4(3)

DUTY_OR_SAFEGUARD: Perform model evaluations, red-teaming, assess systemic risks, report serious incidents, ensure cybersecurity
CONDITION: GPAI models with cumulative training compute > 10^25 FLOPs or designated by Commission
REMEDY_OR_ENFORCEMENT: Administrative fines up to EUR 15M or 3% global turnover (Art. 101)
LIMITATIONS: Codes of practice provide presumption of conformity until harmonised standards exist
